title: Oracle C2M Log Analysis & Health Monitoring (SLO Assurance)
author_notes: Effort tier: T3 (Oracle Utilities C2M + WebLogic 14c administration; middleware/database/integration work, production-impact care).

Oracle Utilities C2M/CC&B/MDM + WebLogic 14c authored from Oracle's official product + OUAF docs; version-specific details (C2M 25.4/min v2.9, WebLogic 14c) cited or flagged 'verify for your version'; My-Oracle-Support-gated patches/notes are pointed to, not reproduced. Automation is WLST (Jython)/shell/SQL, not PowerShell.
hook: Turn C2M logs into health and uptime you can prove
problem: C2M and WebLogic produce a lot of logs — and the signal that keeps uptime high is buried in them. This solution establishes C2M log analysis and health monitoring: where the logs are (OUAF, WebLogic, batch), what to watch, how to detect issues early, and how to track system health against service-level objectives — so you maximize uptime and catch problems early, pilot-first.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the C2M/WebLogic log landscape (OUAF, server, batch), the health signals, and the SLO model.
Requirements Guide — each prerequisite with how to verify/implement (log access, health metrics, SLO definitions, alerting).
Implementation Guide — exact steps to locate and standardize logs, define the health checks and early-warning signals, track against SLOs, and validate, pilot-first.

5 automation scripts (WLST/Jython, shell & SQL) — environment/config discovery, per-node validation, a health/coverage report, safe remediation (dry-run by default), and a scope/target helper — authentic to C2M & WebLogic administration.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (logs accessible, health tracked, SLOs measured) plus Best Practices for log hygiene and early detection.
short: Establish C2M log analysis and health monitoring — where the logs are, what to watch, early detection, and SLO tracking — so you maximize uptime and catch problems early, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
